ADDITIONAL OWNER-BOUND AMEND on exact digest 7f675eab082443777289095ddd37c0ec3556ed968e43018d6cdf628d09f100bd.

The latest owner instruction reasserts pure HTML/CSS, no JavaScript, no external resources, openable from the filesystem. This exact digest still says the owner clauses do not forbid JavaScript at section 2.1, permits JavaScript in the base profile at section 3.1, permits it again in the proposed network-independent profile, and leaves the JavaScript strategy open. Those statements are now stale.

Required repair: the canonical preview profile forbids script elements, inline event handlers, runtime JavaScript data records, and automatically loaded external resources; all essential initial content, status, evidence, projection inventories, navigation targets, and textual twins are present in self-contained HTML/CSS with inline SVG where used. Direct filesystem opening remains required. Any future interactive JavaScript profile is a separate deferred profile and cannot be required for canonical conformance without new owner authority.

Add a local-open mutation court that inserts a script element, an inline handler, and an automatically loaded external resource one at a time; each must refuse canonical-profile satisfaction while preserving any valid scientific/result artifacts. CodexHtml is the current positive control. This is in addition to, not instead of, the decoded-identity and atomic-exclusive-publication repairs already recorded.
